title: 第17章 暴击术第18章 例如白牧野同学
lines: 第17章暴击术
安全区内，一间小密室里，五个人聚在一起，小心翼翼、全神贯注的围着那个变异宝箱。
昏暗的灯光下，每个人的眼睛都贼亮。
“哈哈。”
“哈哈哈！”
“哈哈哈哈！”
不是三个人在笑，只有单谷一个人，笑得像个地主家的傻儿子。
“白哥，以后你就是我哥！初级符纸多少钱一张？明天送你一千张！咱下次去次元空间，带它三五百张，看谁不顺眼，扔符！可劲的扔，就是个扔！”
“白痴。”姬彩衣瞪了他一眼。
单谷看着她：“你不觉得这样很爽吗？刷刷刷，一通扔符，扔在那些该死的次元空间怪物脸上！炸他个人仰马翻！”
“扔符不需要精神力吗？”已经缓过来的司音在一旁弱弱问道。
姬彩衣呵呵冷笑一声，刘志远认真的点点头：“需要。”
“呃……”单谷露出沉思的表情，然后转过头，一脸认真的看着白牧野：“白哥，我觉得吧，你得好好补补！”
白牧野搓搓手：“开箱子！”
单谷的注意力顿时被转移，兴奋的道：“开开开！”
司音和姬彩衣也是一脸期待。
城际副本每周一次，宝箱开出来的东西也是多种多样，品类繁多。
技能、丹药、材料、武器……有时候甚至是现金兑换券。
简单粗暴。
不管是什么，价值都差不多在五万块钱左右。
但今天的是变异宝箱！
它的价值，在五十万左右！
是普通宝箱的十倍。
不管能够开出什么，肯定都不会差。
几个人都眼巴巴的看着刘志远，他是队长，开箱子这种事，他说了算。
刘志远看了一眼白牧野：“今天咱们能够得到宝箱，功劳最大的人就是你，你来开吧！”
“功劳最大的人是彩衣，没有她的话，我们不可能成功。”白牧野看着众人，一脸认真。
其实有句话他没好意思告诉大家，他手黑！
老头子虽然不让白牧野过早接触虚拟仓，但这并不妨碍白牧野通过个人智脑玩些小游戏。
那些开箱子的经历简直是一部抽奖黑历史。
手不是一般的黑！
欧皇？
在他这从来都不存在的。
“没有你的符篆，我根本不可能抢到宝箱啊，所以还是你来开吧。”姬彩衣推辞道。
“哎呀你们真是墨迹，要不我开！”单谷在一旁着急的道。
姬彩衣瞪了他一眼，忽然笑起来：“你来开也行，但是……”
“但是什么？”单谷手都已经放在宝箱上了。
“如果开出你和我都能用的技能书……”
姬彩衣话还没说完，单谷便哈哈大笑道：“技能书？你想多了吧？再说哪有那么巧的事？要是开出你我都能用的，归你！”
content_en:
Chapter 17 Critical Strike Technique
In the safe area, in a small secret room, five people gathered together, carefully and attentively surrounding the mutated treasure box.
Under the dim light, everyone's eyes were very bright.
"Haha."
"Hahaha!"
"Hahahaha!"
There were not three people laughing, but Shan Gu alone, smiling like a silly son of a landlord.
"Brother Bai, you will be my brother from now on! How much does a junior talisman paper cost? I will give you a thousand pieces tomorrow! Next time we go to the dimensional space, we will take three to five hundred of them. If someone doesn't like it, throw the talisman! Throw it vigorously, just throw it!"
"Idiot." Ji Caiyi glared at him.
Shan Gu looked at her: "Don't you think it's great? Throw the talismans at the faces of those damn dimensional monsters! Blow them up!"
"Does it take mental strength to throw a talisman?" Si Yin, who had already recovered, asked weakly from the side.
Ji Caiyi sneered, and Liu Zhiyuan nodded seriously: "Need it."
"Uh..." Shan Gu showed a thoughtful expression, then turned his head and looked at Bai Muye seriously: "Brother Bai, I think so, you have to make up for it!"
Bai Muye rubbed his hands: "Open the box!"
Shan Gu's attention was immediately diverted and he said excitedly: "Go, go, go!"
Si Yin and Ji Caiyi also looked forward to it.
Intercity dungeons are held once a week, and the treasure chests contain a wide variety of items.
Skills, elixirs, materials, weapons... sometimes even cash coupons.
Simple and crude.
No matter what it is, the value is about 50,000 yuan.
But today’s is a mutated treasure chest!
Its value is around half a million!
It is ten times larger than an ordinary treasure chest.
No matter what can be offered, it will definitely be good.
Several people looked at Liu Zhiyuan eagerly. He was the captain, and he had the final say on things like opening boxes.
Liu Zhiyuan glanced at Bai Muye: "We can get the treasure box today, and the person who deserves the most credit is you. Open it!"
"The person who deserves the most credit is Cai Yi. Without her, we wouldn't have been able to succeed." Bai Muye looked at everyone with a serious look on his face.
In fact, there is something he is embarrassed to tell everyone: he is evil!
Although the old man did not let Bai Muye come into contact with the virtual warehouse prematurely, this did not prevent Bai Muye from playing some small games through his personal brain.
Those experiences of opening boxes are simply a dark history of lottery.
The hands are not ordinary black!
European Emperor?
It never existed for him.
"Without your talisman, it's impossible for me to grab the treasure chest, so you'd better open it." Ji Caiyi declined.
"Oh, you guys are really ink. How about I drive!" Shan Gu said anxiously from the side.
Ji Caiyi glared at him and suddenly laughed: "You can come and drive, but..."
"But what?" Shan Gu's hand was already on the treasure chest.
"If there is a skill book that both you and I can use..."
Before Ji Caiyi finished speaking, Shan Gu laughed loudly and said: "Skill book? Are you overthinking it? Besides, how can it be such a coincidence? If I open it for you and I can use it, it's yours!"
